applicability: Central evidence and authored assessment display for a selected subject.
conditions: The payload is the requested subject owner read and preserves record currentness, applicability and provenance.
Candidate-level execution is labelled as candidate input, separately from authored subject judgment.
exclusions: A family-selected payload cannot establish a member assessment absence.
Missing or unreadable record channels are not a favorable or unassessed default.
No passing execution creates a semantic assessment.
statement: The central evidence view displays the selected subject owner's authored assessment with its recorded currentness and applicability, separately from candidate execution observations.
